behavior: In that same empty-cache, unreachable-network scenario, the error that resolveInstall() settles with names all three of the pinned version, the specific host it could not reach, and JDTLS_HOME as the override escape hatch -- an error message missing any one of the three does not satisfy this behavior.
rationale: Boundedness (TCON-PROV-0006) and message completeness are independently falsifiable: an implementation can fail fast within the deadline yet surface an opaque stack trace, or eventually produce a correct-content message after hanging past the deadline [INV-PROV-4]; a fixed-content example asserting all three named facts are present catches the former class of defect that a settles-in-time assertion alone would pass.
